scientific_scope: preregistered synthetic mechanism, calibrated DA, and canonical-human non-inferiority development; factual human DA remains locked until candidate freeze
selection_rule: noncompensatory hard gates followed only by the frozen RDX-09 tie-break
tie_break: known-truth Milo localization, factual-z predictive loss, u cross-seed kNN Jaccard, then trainable parameter count
multimodal_ranking_rule: RNA-only scVI is excluded from protein, multimodal predictive-loss, and multimodal ELBO rankings.

validation_objective_history.estimand: every logged validation objective value with its original epoch index
validation_objective_history.aggregation: ordered complete epoch series; never last-value only
validation_objective_history.missing_or_no_call: missing, empty, or nonfinite history invalidates the fit

best_checkpoint_identity.estimand: best monitored validation epoch, value, and exact restored state SHA-256
best_checkpoint_identity.missing_or_no_call: missing monitor, checkpoint, or state digest invalidates the fit

rna_reconstruction_loss.estimand: mean per-cell summed RNA negative log likelihood at the restored checkpoint
rna_reconstruction_loss.missing_or_no_call: missing or nonfinite value invalidates the fit

protein_reconstruction_loss.estimand: mean per-cell summed observed-protein negative log likelihood at the restored checkpoint
protein_reconstruction_loss.split: held-out validation cells and observed protein entries
protein_reconstruction_loss.missing_or_no_call: null for RNA-only scVI; missing or nonfinite for a multimodal row invalidates the fit

kl_z.estimand: mean held-out factual-z KL contribution under the model's declared hierarchy
kl_z.missing_or_no_call: missing or nonfinite value invalidates the fit

kl_u.estimand: mean held-out KL from q(u) to the declared u prior
kl_u.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; missing or nonfinite for MrTotalVI invalidates the fit

u_posterior_scale.estimand: mean posterior standard deviation over held-out cells and u coordinates
u_posterior_scale.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; nonpositive or nonfinite scale invalidates MrTotalVI

factual_z_posterior_scale.estimand: mean posterior standard deviation over held-out cells and factual-z coordinates
factual_z_posterior_scale.missing_or_no_call: nonpositive, missing, or nonfinite scale invalidates the fit

u_latent_variance.estimand: mean sample variance across u coordinates
u_latent_variance.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; nonfinite value invalidates MrTotalVI

factual_z_latent_variance.estimand: mean sample variance across factual-z coordinates
factual_z_latent_variance.missing_or_no_call: missing or nonfinite value invalidates the fit

u_effective_rank.estimand: entropy effective rank of the u covariance eigenvalues
u_effective_rank.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; rank below half the configured dimension fails the redesign gate

factual_z_effective_rank.estimand: entropy effective rank of the factual-z covariance eigenvalues
factual_z_effective_rank.missing_or_no_call: missing or nonfinite value invalidates the fit; rank below half dimension fails

registered_residual_magnitude.estimand: mean absolute sample-residual value over all registered residual rows
registered_residual_magnitude.split: held-out validation cells and all registered targets
registered_residual_magnitude.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; missing or nonfinite residuals invalidate MrTotalVI

registered_residual_gradient_norm.estimand: root-sum-square loss gradient over the registered residual embedding table
registered_residual_gradient_norm.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; missing, zero, or nonfinite norm fails MrTotalVI

registered_residual_gradient_coverage.estimand: fraction of registered residual rows with a finite nonzero accumulated gradient
registered_residual_gradient_coverage.aggregation: nonzero rows divided by registered rows
registered_residual_gradient_coverage.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; any untrained row fails MrTotalVI

trainable_parameter_count.estimand: number of model parameters with requires_grad true

wall_time_seconds.estimand: elapsed wall time for the declared training fit
wall_time_seconds.missing_or_no_call: missing or negative value invalidates the fit

peak_memory_bytes.estimand: maximum observed resident or accelerator memory increase during training
peak_memory_bytes.missing_or_no_call: missing or negative value invalidates the fit

u_linear_cka.estimand: centered linear CKA between cell-aligned u embeddings
u_linear_cka.split: same evaluation cells in paired fits
u_linear_cka.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; cell-lineage mismatch or nonfinite value invalidates the comparison

u_orthogonal_procrustes_disparity.estimand: squared normalized u disparity after optimal rotation or reflection
u_orthogonal_procrustes_disparity.split: same evaluation cells in paired fits
u_orthogonal_procrustes_disparity.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; cell or latent-dimension mismatch invalidates the comparison

factual_z_linear_cka.estimand: centered linear CKA between cell-aligned factual-z embeddings
factual_z_linear_cka.split: same evaluation cells in paired fits
factual_z_linear_cka.missing_or_no_call: cell-lineage mismatch or nonfinite value invalidates the comparison

factual_z_orthogonal_procrustes_disparit.estimand: squared normalized factual-z disparity after optimal rotation or reflection
factual_z_orthogonal_procrustes_disparit.split: same evaluation cells in paired fits
factual_z_orthogonal_procrustes_disparit.missing_or_no_call: cell or latent-dimension mismatch invalidates the comparison

u_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.estimand: mean per-cell 15-neighbor set Jaccard over every declared training-seed pair in u
u_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.split: exact same evaluation cell-ID set across seeds
u_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.aggregation: mean over cells then declared seed pairs
u_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; missing seed pair or cell mismatch invalidates the grid

factual_z_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.estimand: mean per-cell 15-neighbor set Jaccard over every declared training-seed pair in factual z
factual_z_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.split: exact same evaluation cell-ID set across seeds
factual_z_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.aggregation: mean over cells then declared seed pairs
factual_z_cross_seed_knn_jaccard_k15.missing_or_no_call: missing seed pair or cell mismatch invalidates the grid

u_state_balanced_accuracy.estimand: out-of-fold balanced accuracy of evaluation-only state prediction from u
u_state_balanced_accuracy.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; inadequate classes or nonfinite value invalidates MrTotalVI

u_knn_state_accuracy_k15.estimand: balanced accuracy of majority state among each cell's 15 nearest nonself u neighbors
u_knn_state_accuracy_k15.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; invalid k or state labels invalidate MrTotalVI

factual_z_state_balanced_accuracy.estimand: out-of-fold balanced accuracy of evaluation-only state prediction from factual z
factual_z_state_balanced_accuracy.missing_or_no_call: inadequate classes or nonfinite value invalidates the fit

factual_z_knn_state_accuracy_k15.estimand: balanced accuracy of majority state among each cell's 15 nearest nonself factual-z neighbors
factual_z_knn_state_accuracy_k15.missing_or_no_call: invalid k or state labels invalidate the fit

u_within_state_sample_predictability.estimand: out-of-fold balanced accuracy for biological-sample prediction after subtracting evaluation-state centroids from u
u_within_state_sample_predictability.split: held-out evaluation cells only; labels never enter training
u_within_state_sample_predictability.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; inadequate sample classes invalidates MrTotalVI

u_within_state_sample_predictability_per.estimand: 95th percentile of seeded within-state sample-label permutation balanced accuracy
u_within_state_sample_predictability_per.split: same held-out evaluation cells and folds as the observed leakage score
u_within_state_sample_predictability_per.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; incomplete permutation grid invalidates MrTotalVI

u_technical_batch_mixing.estimand: one minus chance-corrected technical-batch balanced predictability after state-centering u
u_technical_batch_mixing.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; inadequate batch classes invalidates MrTotalVI

factual_z_technical_batch_mixing.estimand: one minus chance-corrected technical-batch balanced predictability after state-centering factual z
factual_z_technical_batch_mixing.missing_or_no_call: inadequate batch classes or nonfinite value invalidates the fit

rna_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.estimand: mean negative log probability over observed held-out RNA entries
rna_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.unit: negative log probability per observed RNA entry
rna_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.aggregation: mean over observed RNA entries, independent of protein feature count
rna_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.missing_or_no_call: missing, empty, or nonfinite observed entries invalidate the fit

protein_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.estimand: mean negative log probability over observed held-out protein entries
protein_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.unit: negative log probability per observed protein entry
protein_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.split: held-out validation cells and measured proteins
protein_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.aggregation: mean over observed protein entries, independent of RNA feature count
protein_heldout_negative_log_likelihood.missing_or_no_call: null for scVI; missing, empty, or nonfinite multimodal entries invalidate the fit

multimodal_heldout_predictive_loss.estimand: sum of separately feature-normalized RNA and protein held-out negative log likelihoods
multimodal_heldout_predictive_loss.aggregation: RNA mean per observed entry plus protein mean per observed entry
multimodal_heldout_predictive_loss.missing_or_no_call: null for RNA-only scVI; either missing modality invalidates a multimodal row

rna_posterior_predictive_calibration.estimand: mean absolute central-interval coverage error at nominal 0.50, 0.80, and 0.90 for RNA
rna_posterior_predictive_calibration.aggregation: mean over three interval-level absolute errors
rna_posterior_predictive_calibration.missing_or_no_call: fewer than two predictive draws or nonfinite values invalidate the fit

protein_posterior_predictive_calibration.estimand: mean absolute central-interval coverage error at nominal 0.50, 0.80, and 0.90 for protein
protein_posterior_predictive_calibration.aggregation: mean over three interval-level absolute errors
protein_posterior_predictive_calibration.missing_or_no_call: null for scVI; fewer than two draws or nonfinite multimodal values invalidate the fit

centering_max_abs.estimand: maximum absolute registered-target mean of centered sample residuals
centering_max_abs.split: evaluation cells and all registered targets
centering_max_abs.missing_or_no_call: null for stock models; nonfinite value or value above 1e-6 fails centered MrTotalVI

latent_all_finite.estimand: indicator that every evaluated coordinate in each required named representation is finite
latent_all_finite.missing_or_no_call: missing indicator or any nonfinite coordinate invalidates the fit

milo_primary_failed_fit_count.estimand: number of primary paired Milo neighborhood fits reporting failure
milo_primary_failed_fit_count.split: named representation and declared DA scenario
milo_primary_failed_fit_count.missing_or_no_call: missing diagnostics invalidate the run; any positive count fails

milo_primary_na_fit_count.estimand: number of primary paired Milo neighborhoods with missing inferential output
milo_primary_na_fit_count.split: named representation and declared DA scenario
milo_primary_na_fit_count.missing_or_no_call: missing diagnostics invalidate the run; any positive count fails

milo_fdp_spatialfdr_0_10.estimand: false discoveries divided by discoveries at SpatialFDR 0.10 under exogenous neighborhood truth
milo_fdp_spatialfdr_0_10.missing_or_no_call: undefined with zero discoveries is recorded by the frozen no-call rule; missing truth invalidates evidence

milo_power_spatialfdr_0_10.estimand: true discovered DA neighborhoods divided by true DA neighborhoods at SpatialFDR 0.10
milo_power_spatialfdr_0_10.split: known-truth Milo scenarios with DA signal
milo_power_spatialfdr_0_10.missing_or_no_call: null for scenarios with no true DA neighborhoods; missing eligible truth invalidates evidence

milo_localization_spatialfdr_0_10.estimand: preregistered overlap localization of SpatialFDR 0.10 discoveries to true DA neighborhoods
milo_localization_spatialfdr_0_10.split: known-truth Milo scenarios with localized DA signal
milo_localization_spatialfdr_0_10.missing_or_no_call: missing eligible truth or neighborhood lineage invalidates evidence

milo_seed_stability.estimand: cross-seed agreement of signed Milo neighborhood effect evidence on lineage-matched neighborhoods
milo_seed_stability.split: same scenario instance and named representation across declared seeds
milo_seed_stability.missing_or_no_call: missing seed pair or incompatible neighborhood lineage invalidates evidence
